# im-looking-for

> Local, cross-platform search of a computer's files by their content (photos, PDFs and scans, documents, audio,
> video) using EmbeddingGemma 2 via llama.cpp. Command `ilf`; MCP server `ilf mcp`; `--json` on every command.
> Nothing leaves the computer.

## For agents using it

- [Agent guide](docs/agents.md): connecting over MCP, tools, JSON shapes, exit codes, how to read scores
- [Agent skill](skills/im-looking-for/SKILL.md): step-by-step use of the `ilf` CLI
- [README](README.md): install, the app, what files are read, limits

## For agents changing it

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): code layout, invariants, how to test
